parsed.post: Discarding the latest result (1.007600) as it regressed from my best (1.006925). It seems WARMUP_RATIO=0.1 was slightly too high for this configuration. Reverting to my best and testing WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 to see if the lower warmup ratio found by others improves stability and convergence for DEPTH=6 and ASPECT_RATIO=64.
parsed.description: Testing WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 on the previous best configuration (DEPTH=6, ASPECT_RATIO=64, MATRIX_LR=0.05, TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=524288) to improve stability.
